defect_found_and_fixed.what: scripts/doctor.sh --self-test aborted on the production host with UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xa3 in position 45, naming no file.
defect_found_and_fixed.root_cause: An earlier macOS-side copy left nine AppleDouble sidecars in the deploy tree. Two of them sat beside src/social_archive/api.py and db.py, and the self-test compiles every rglob("*.py") match, so it tried to compile a 163-byte binary resource fork.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: doctor.sh now detects sidecars before the compile loop and fails with the offending paths; the nine files were removed from production; a repo-wide regression prevents them being committed or deployed again.

doctor_self_test.side_effects: none; the self-test does not contact Docker, loopback, or the network, and does not read or write runtime or Secret

note_on_deployment_probe.observation: scripts/deployment_probe.py --network-confirmed reports BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT for the library host with https status 403.
note_on_deployment_probe.interpretation: This is the Cloudflare Access boundary refusing an unauthenticated non-browser request, which is the intended posture for the protected library. The probe classifies any non-200 as blocked, so its verdict must not be read as a deployment defect. The credential-free smoke above records the distinction explicitly.

what_this_does_not_prove: An authenticated Owner browser session through Cloudflare Access; no Access assertion was forged or replayed.
SA-506 backup, restore, degrade and rollback, which is a separate task.
Any account mirror or platform canary.
non_actions: No Cloudflare, Tunnel, DNS, WAF or Access policy was read or changed.
No secret value was printed to terminal, transcript, evidence or Git.
No timer was enabled, no tag or release created, nothing pushed to origin.
